chapter_meta_description: The Ancestral Sovereign warship is forged. The Little Defiant Dragon leaves. Nine lamps rise as multiple Otherworld Ancestral Gods descend upon the Nine Provinces.

og_description: A mysterious Ancestral Sovereign finishes a legendary vessel. The Little Defiant Dragon departs into the Yellow River. Then the nine lamps rise—and the Otherworld Ancestral Gods come.
